caption: The video captures a water-level view down an indoor pool lane, where a dark line runs toward a far wall holding a clock, alarm, ventilation pipes, and a rack of white items, with a small limb at the bottom edge. At the far end, a shirtless person in dark trunks treads water without drifting along the lane, holding one white object at chest height. Throughout the excerpt this person repeatedly lifts the second white object above their head and lowers it again, interspersed with forward leans toward the water surface. Each arm motion and lean churns the water, sending splashes around the body and rippling the lane line. The background stays fixed and the camera remains still. The visible activity is thus confined to the person's continuous handling of the two white objects.
relations: Person treading water at lane end holds one white object at chest height while lifting the second overhead repeatedly.
Each arm lift and forward lean churns the water, sending splashes around the body and rippling the dark lane line.
The fixed far wall with clock, alarm, pipes, and white-item rack stays unchanged while the camera remains still.
Visible activity stays confined to the person's continuous handling of the two white objects throughout the excerpt.
